caption: The drawing consists of two outlined vases, both depicted against a plain, cream-colored background. Each vase has two handles near the top on either side, and both are outlined in black. On the left vase, there is a simple floral motif on the front, drawn in shades of blue; the flower has several petals and a curving stem with two leaves. Light blue coloring is also present at the base of each handle. On the right vase, the front contains an inscription within a scalloped border, which reads: "C. Crolius Manufacturer Manhattan Wells New York." The same light blue color is used at the base of the handles on this vase as well. Both vases share a similar overall shape, featuring a wide body that tapers slightly towards the base and a narrow neck with a slightly flared rim. The rest of the page is unadorned, leaving significant empty space around the two vases.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
